overlay: Build a React/TypeScript profile editor, exporting App from src/app.tsx. Start with heading Profile, saved name Ada, and an Edit profile button. It opens a modal named Edit profile with description Update your display name, visibly labeled Name initialized from saved state, Save, and Cancel. Empty or whitespace-only saves keep it open and show Enter a name associated with the field. Valid save trims the name, updates the profile, and closes. Cancel and Escape discard edits. Reopening uses the saved name and clears old errors. Opening moves focus inside; Tab and Shift+Tab must wrap within dialog controls rather than move into browser chrome. Dismissal returns focus to Edit profile. Native HTML and custom React are allowed.
form: Build a React/TypeScript contact form, exporting App from src/app.tsx. Heading Add contact. Provide visibly labeled Name and Email inputs, an I accept the terms checkbox, Save contact, and Reset. Initially fields are empty and terms unchecked. On submit, trim both strings. A missing or whitespace name shows Enter a name; an email must match /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/ or show Enter a valid email; unchecked terms show Accept the terms. Show all applicable custom errors on submit, keep the form editable, and associate each error with its control. Do not let native browser validation prevent custom feedback. Successful submit shows a live status with Saved <trimmed name>, <trimmed email>. Keep the entered values and checked terms after saving. Reset clears fields, checkbox, all errors, and saved status. Validation errors may clear on edits or on the next submit. Native HTML and custom React are allowed.
directory: Build a React/TypeScript people directory, exporting App from src/app.tsx. Heading People directory. Provide accessible tabs People and Summary, named tab list Directory views, with automatic horizontal arrow-key activation and matching labeled panels. People is initially selected. People contains a visibly labeled Search people input and a named Clear search command for nonempty input. Filter immediately by case-insensitive trimmed substring of name or email; Escape in search clears it. Show a named People table or grid with Name, Email, and Actions columns. Records are Ada / ada@example.com, Grace / grace@example.com, and Linus / linus@example.com, initially ascending by name. Name is the row-header column and sortable; activation toggles ascending/descending with accessible sort state and actually reorders rows. Each row has View <name>, updating a live status to Selected <name> without switching tabs. With no results show No matches and no record rows. Summary shows 3 people. Search, sort, and selection state survive switching tabs. On returning to People, restore its current filtered rows. Native HTML and custom React are allowed. The outer page must not overflow at 390px; the table may scroll within its own bounded container.
